### Your Key to Usefulness
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-16-2023.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:26
Points:
- Early church gatherings were often composed of unimpressive, weak, and lowly individuals.
- God does not depend on human power, prestige, or status to advance His kingdom.
- The gospel seems like foolishness to the world so that human pride is eliminated.
- Christians do not need to project false strength or perfection to win others to Christ.
- Human weakness serves as the setting through which God displays His sufficiency and strength.

### What God Chooses to Accomplish His Will
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-may-12.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 1:27
Points:
- God frequently nudges believers toward tasks and callings that exceed their personal capabilities.
- Self-reliance and feeling in control can subtly erode an awareness of the need for God.
- God places believers in uncomfortable situations so they recognize His power at work.
- The redemption story itself confounds human expectations through the humility of the cross.
- God works through human limitations so that His strength and glory are clearly seen.
